"The control plane's components make global decisions about the cluster (for example, scheduling)"; Control Plane Components: "Manage the overall state of the cluster"; etcd: "Consistent and highly-available key value store for all API server data."

kind Configuration: "kind: Cluster" specifies that we are configuring a KIND cluster and "apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4" indicates the version of KIND's config being used. "You can set a specific Kubernetes version by setting the node's container image." Docker: pulling by digest lets you "pin" an image. Executed `kubectl get nodes`: v1.34.11 on all nodes.

cluster-up.sh@stage-2 lines 10-19 as stated: grep -qx donhang, echo, `kubectl config use-context kind-donhang`, else `kind create cluster ... --wait 180s 2>&1 | awk '!done { print } /^kubectl cluster-info/ { done = 1 }'`, then kubectl wait. kind v0.33.0 create.go logSalutation: picks one of four salutations at random (rand.Intn) after printing "kubectl cluster-info --context ...", so awk drops only that greeting.
